## VERDICT payloads on active OPEN findings

MERGE C0014 <- C0004  
Evidence: C0004 and C0014 have the same root cause in EN-30. The document states any two of three pumps meet 46 L/s and one pump delivers 55% of duty. Losing two pumps leaves one pump, which delivers `0.55 × 46 = 25.3 L/s < 46 L/s`. Both findings identify the same contradiction: the arrangement tolerates one pump failure, not two. VERIFIED: TRUE.

MERGE C0008 <- C0017  
Evidence: C0017 and C0008 have the same EN-14 root cause. With `n=8`, unknown population standard deviation, and printed sample standard deviation `s=5.51 MPa`, the correct two-sided 95% mean interval uses `t_{0.975,7} ≈ 2.365`, not `z=1.96`. The interval is approximately `289.40 ± 2.365×1.95 = [284.8, 294.0] MPa`, not `[285.6, 293.2] MPa`. VERIFIED: TRUE.

MERGE C0008 <- C0023  
Evidence: C0023 is another duplicate of the same EN-14 confidence-interval defect. Same location, same statistical mechanism, same corrected interval. VERIFIED: TRUE.

MERGE C0008 <- C0002  
Evidence: C0002 is another duplicate of the same EN-14 confidence-interval defect. Same root cause: normal approximation used where small-sample Student-t interval is required. VERIFIED: TRUE.

MERGE C0003 <- C0022
